about: ecl_timing 0.1.0 inputs for job hd11239-timing-v1 (MV2, Munim, Inc.; made with AI agents; written 27 Nov 2026 before the job ran). Times are BTJD = BJD_TDB - 2457000. HD 11239's reference is Gaia DR3's double-lined orbit (nss_two_body_orbit, source 4961129715887496320): conjunction times converted with Gaia time = BTJD + 1802.5, exactly as in the pre-registration findings/2026-11-26-hd11239-tess-prereg.md; P is Gaia's (+/- 3.9e-5 d). 'alt' is the linear ephemeris that sb2-ebfit-v2 fitted to TESS sectors 3 and 30 jointly. The controls' references are the sb2-ebfit-v2 fits to their SPOC 2-minute light curves (data/sb2-ebfit-v2/ebfit_summary.json); their TESS-SPOC and QLP full-frame-image light curves test the FFI pipelines' timing against SPOC in the same sectors. Secondary conjunction = primary + P/2 + (2P/pi) e cos(omega).
